speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress. Can you tell me the gestational age at birth and whether the baby was born via Cesarean section or vaginal delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: Was antenatal corticosteroid therapy administered to the mother prior to delivery? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Fine reticular granulation with ground glass appearance on both lungs

speaker: Doctor
text: The chest X-ray findings of diffuse reticular granulation and ground-glass appearance, combined with prematurity and lack of antenatal steroids, are classic for Respiratory Distress Syndrome. DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (NRDS)
